OSU Total Health Care Center (THCC) utilizes 340B program savings and revenue in direct support of its mission to serve underserved and vulnerable patient populations in two primary ways. 

First, program savings are applied to assist patients experiencing financial hardship in accessing prescribed medications they would otherwise be unable to afford, consistent with the health center's Sliding Fee Discount Program. 

Second, program revenue supports the salaries and fringe benefits of clinical and patient support personnel whose roles directly advance care access and quality, including clinical pharmacy staff, Community Health Workers, and care coordinators. 

All 340B funds are reinvested into health center operations consistent with HRSA requirements and 340B program integrity guidelines.
